candidate_evidence.quote: Salovum/SPC flakes: Egg yolk powder and specially processed cereals
Since Salovum® is not classified as a drug, clinical trials have only required ethics approval.

role_evidence.quote: [DIETARY_SUPPLEMENT] Salovum/SPC flakes: Egg yolk powder and specially processed cereals
Salovum®, a product based on the egg yolk powder B221®, contains high levels of AF and is classified as a "food for special medical purposes"

agents.drug_class_hint: dietary product: egg yolk powder enriched with antisecretory factor plus specially processed oat cereal

coder_notes: Dietary supplement / food for special medical purposes, not a medicine; stated purpose is tumour-induced cerebral oedema (symptom control). Even if viewed as supportive, no candidate. Mixed brain tumour population (glioblastoma, metastases, meningioma); treatment setting not stated.
